example.title: Beaver Creek bridge, county road NE 50 Ave over upper Beaver Creek
example.place: south of 230 Rd (Russell County line), Barton County, KS
example.source: Wikimedia Commons (Category:Beaver Creek bridge, Barton County rd NE 50 Ave)

brief: Single semicircular WPA stone arch culvert of 1941 under a gravel county road on the open plains: rock-faced buff limestone blocks in even courses, rough-faced voussoirs with a smooth keystone cut 'WPA' on one face and '1941' on the other, and a low parapet a few courses high capped with a smooth coping, stepping down at the ends. A barbed-wire fence runs up to the headwall; dry grassy channel.

traits.railing_detail: low solid stone parapet with coping
